create_nsynth_config: create an NsynthConfig with gansynth_subset and estimate_f0_and_loudness options for TensorFlow Datasets
build_nsynth_dataset: build the NSynth dataset using BeamBasedBuilder with train, valid, and test splits from TFRecord files
define_nsynth_features: define the NSynth dataset schema with audio, pitch, velocity, instrument metadata, and optional F0 and loudness features
generate_nsynth_splits: generate train, valid, and test split generators with instrument label filtering and GANSynth subset support
estimate_f0_loudness: estimate fundamental frequency using CREPE and compute A-weighted loudness for NSynth audio examples
